article.title: MCM香港把Monchhichi聯乘延伸至海港城活動
article.summary: MAD Thailand報道，MCM安排泰國藝人Freen Sarocha出席香港海港城的Monchhichi聯乘活動。
highlights: 聯乘把日本Monchhichi角色帶到MCM四款經典袋型。
POPBEE報道，香港和澳門先接受專門店WhatsApp預訂，再公開發售。
article.why: 區內零售團隊可把聯乘商品的預訂、公開發售和門店活動設為不同接觸點。
article.next_step: 分開記錄訊息預訂、發售後到店及活動登記，對照各環節的參與情況。
article.detail: MCM以Monchhichi角色改造四款經典袋型。POPBEE報道，香港和澳門先以專門店WhatsApp接受預訂，再公開發售。MAD Thailand另報道，品牌安排Freen Sarocha到海港城參與聯乘活動。零售團隊可參考這種安排，按預訂和門店活動分開記錄參與情況。
article.title_en: MCM extends its Monchhichi collaboration to a Hong Kong Harbour City event
article.summary_en: MAD Thailand reported that MCM scheduled Thai artist Freen Sarocha to appear at its Harbour City Monchhichi collaboration event.
highlights_en: The collection puts the Japanese Monchhichi character on four MCM signature bag styles.
POPBEE reported that Hong Kong and Macau store WhatsApp reservations preceded public sales.
article.why_en: Regional retailers can treat reservations, public sales and store events as distinct customer touchpoints.
article.next_step_en: Measure message reservations, post-launch visits and event registrations separately.
article.detail_en: MCM put the Monchhichi character on four signature bag styles. POPBEE reported WhatsApp reservations through stores in Hong Kong and Macau ahead of public sales. MAD Thailand separately reported a scheduled Harbour City appearance by Freen Sarocha. Retail teams can track reservation and event participation separately when evaluating a similar rollout.
